// Generics, interfaces, aliases and enums for the symbol table (E07-03).
interface Box<T> {
  value: T;
  map<U>(fn: (v: T) => U): Box<U>;
}

type Pair<A, B> = { first: A; second: B };

class Stack<T> {
  private items: T[] = [];
  push(item: T): void {
    this.items.push(item);
  }
  pop(): T | undefined {
    return this.items.pop();
  }
}

enum Level {
  Low,
  High = 5,
}

function first<T>(xs: T[]): T | undefined {
  return xs[0];
}

const level: Level = Level.High;
const pair: Pair<string, number> = { first: "a", second: level };
